author: TeIq
content: Delivered: MinhashIndex trait + MemoryMinhashIndex with config-time band-mismatch validation. NonZeroU16 typed config (num_perm/num_bands/band_rows); NonZeroUsize min_cohort_size. Universal-hash family for the MinHash permutations. LSH banding via per-instance RandomState. CohortObservation carries cohort_id (band-hash), members, similarity_estimate (f32 fraction of matching bands as Jaccard estimate). Rolling-window eviction. Single-emit (band_idx, band_hash) dedup. 8 scenario tests + 2 proptest properties (identical features → identical signatures; threshold-emit) all pass. polaris-backend/src/pattern/{mod,minhash}.rs.
